_comment: Starter providers.json for keysmith: two OpenAI-compatible providers, merged into one file. Copy it to providers.json, DELETE the providers you do not use, export the env vars named under 'keys' (env var NAMES only — never the key values), and verify each base_url and model id with your provider's current docs; these values are examples, not guarantees. Fields per provider: base_url (required; https unless it is a loopback local dev endpoint with allow_insecure true — keysmith refuses non-loopback http because it would send your bearer key in cleartext), keys (required, >= 1 env var name; round-robin order), models (required, public name -> upstream model id; public names must not contain '/'), cooldown_seconds (optional, default 60: rest period after 3 consecutive auth failures), timeout_seconds (optional, default 120), allow_insecure (optional, default false; only useful for loopback local dev endpoints such as a local vLLM — see templates/providers.vllm.json). One provider per file also ships in templates/ (openai, glm, groq, openrouter, vllm), and templates/providers.anthropic-stub.json is the clearly-marked stub for the not-implemented-in-v0.1 Anthropic-native API.
